purpose: Structures the Role A answer for downstream mapping WITHOUT interpreting it. The raw response remains primary evidence; this schema is only a derived view.
hard_rules: The raw response is preserved byte-for-byte and hashed BEFORE this schema is populated. This schema is a derived view, never a replacement.
The packet arm is recorded as A, B1, or B2.
For A and B1, fields A-I correspond to the explicit lettered prompts.

For B2, which deliberately contains NO A-I decomposition, a field may be populated only from an explicit passage whose content directly states that field. The exact source passage must be quoted in transcriber_observations. If assigning the passage to an A-I field would require inference, decomposition, completion, or reinterpretation, the field remains unsettled.

B2 silence on an A-I field is never evidence that the respondent rejects, omits, or lacks that concept. It means only that the ablation packet did not require a separately labelled answer on that axis.
The transcriber may not supply, complete, tidy, or infer any field the respondent left unsettled. 'unsettled' is a valid and expected value.
The transcriber may not translate the respondent's vocabulary into any other framework's vocabulary. Terms are recorded as the respondent used them.
If the transcriber believes a field is implied but not stated, it is recorded as unsettled with the belief noted in transcriber_observations, never promoted into the field.

scope_A.source_item: A for A/B1; explicit passage only for B2
scope_A.note: System classes in scope and excluded, in the respondent's own words.

observables_B.source_item: B for A/B1; explicit passage only for B2
observables_B.note: Facts or behaviours the respondent says matter.

droppable_C.source_item: C for A/B1; explicit passage only for B2

carryover_D.source_item: D for A/B1; explicit passage only for B2
carryover_D.note: The respondent's own definition of what carrying over means.

sameness_E.source_item: E for A/B1; explicit passage only for B2

legitimate_rewritings_F.source_item: F for A/B1; explicit passage only for B2

assumptions_G.source_item: G for A/B1; explicit passage only for B2

comparison_H.source_item: H for A/B1; explicit passage only for B2
comparison_H.note: Whether the respondent offers any way to compare competing answers, and what they say makes it natural. This field is load-bearing only when Role A actually supplied a criterion; the adjudication procedure never manufactures one.

no_single_answer_I.source_item: I for A/B1; explicit passage only for B2

transcriber_observations.note: Anything the transcriber noticed that is NOT part of the answer. For B2, include exact source passages used to populate any A-I field. Observations never become respondent claims.

optional_architecture_phase.gate: Run only after the contract answer is declared final, preserved byte-for-byte and hashed, and BEFORE the contamination questionnaire and before any reveal. See freeze-procedure-v1.0.md section 3. Ordering it after the questionnaire is a protocol violation, because the questionnaire discloses that a target architecture exists.
optional_architecture_phase.question_asked: Given the answer you have just finalised, determine whether it implies any minimal or canonical way of structuring such a description. State and justify whatever conclusion you reach. If you consult any additional source for this phase, list it.

derivation_from_own_contract.note: How the respondent says it follows from their own answer above.

additional_sources.note: Every source consulted only after S5 was asked. Empty list if none.

optional_architecture_phase.separation_rule: This is a SECOND frozen artifact with its own hash. Contract-to-contract and architecture-to-architecture comparisons are reported separately and are never collapsed into a single agreement score.
optional_architecture_phase.contamination_note: S5 discloses that a structuring question is of interest. It cannot contaminate the contract answer, already sealed. It does contaminate the architecture answer as to the existence of such a question, though not as to any particular structure. Disclosed on every architecture-phase claim.
